purpose: choose, per rule, the warm-up count k for an RL starting prompt (TASK33); report every rule, including failures
pools: data/fewshot/warmup/<rule>.v1.jsonl (warmup_seed 0); pool digest recorded with each result
k0_reference: naive prompt on the same 50 questions (rule_naive_train200_<rule>, 4 samples each; 0/200 for every rule)

band.metric: strict upstream compliance among known T1 grades, counting only non-empty thinking that contains letters

tolerances.t1_math_accuracy: at least the naive panel's T1 math minus 5 points (absolute)

rule: the smallest k in k_order whose panel result is inside the band and meets every tolerance; otherwise 'no qualifying prompt'. Band, tolerances, pools and teachers do not change after any result.
diagnostics_reported: questions with mixed compliance across their 8 samples
questions with mixed final reward (GRPO signal)
compliance x final-reward cells and leakage
T1 math, final reward, median T1 tokens, prefix tokens
after_selection: the chosen k is measured once on val positions 0-99 x 25 samples (validation, not a sealed test)
